newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar mixed in narrow range.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar mixed in narrow range.

text.p: LIFFE sugar futures traded were mixed in a narrow range, in the absence of features which would give the market new direction, traders said.
By 1657 GMT March was unchanged at $298.10 on volume of 812 lots. May was down 50 cents at $297.70 on volume of 818 lots. Total volume at that point was 1,886 lots.
"There was a bit of pre-restitution selling early in the day," one trader, referring to the EU's sugar tender Wednesday.
But New York's performance helped bring LIFFE futures up later in the day, he said.
Traders noted active March/May spread trading, particularly during the early part of the day.
The European Union's sugar management committee will discuss the final sugar balance sheet for 1995/96 on Wednesday, an EU official said on Monday.
The committee will also discuss the provisional balance sheet for 1996/97, the official said.
Pankobirlik, an influential union of Turkish sugar beet cooperatives, expected 2.05 million tonnes of overall sugar production in 1997/98, up from 1.85 million tonnes in 1996/97, it said in a report.
Turkey's state-run sugar refinery Turkseker is planning to export 50,000 tonnes of sugar soon, its general manager Selahhatin Hun said on Tuesday.
"We are planning to sell about 50,000 tonnes more after our first sale two weeks ago," Hun told Reuters.
Mexican sugar cane growers, threatening to stage a "down machetes" strike against industrialists, won a 26 percent increase in cane prices, daily newspaper Reforma said Tuesday.
